title: Consolidate maintained context and refresh open issues
summary: We reduce duplicated guidance across root documents and keep requirements in ARCHITECTURE, contributor checks in CONTRIBUTING and agent constraints in CLAUDE. We retire frozen incident/import reports from the checkout with exact Git references, remove stale execution and four-bar instructions, and integrate the TRAINING prerequisites into its nine-step order. We update issues #18, #19 and #20 with current paths, measured outcomes and remaining implementation. The site now distinguishes the passing optimized trajectory from failed PPO and removes stale pending-evaluation text. We preserve acceptance gates, model bytes, recordings and published history. This change launches no training.
next: Start the reward audit in TRAINING when requested. Assign owners/reviewers and define each native experiment before dispatch. Keep walking, mapping and mission acceptance open.
